description: This file defines the CustomShippingQuoteWeightItem class, which extends CustomShippingQuoteItem and implements JSONAware. It models a shipping quote item with additional weight and pricing details, and provides JSON serialization.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuoteWeightItem
classes.description: A class representing a custom shipping quote item with maximum weight and price text, capable of JSON serialization.

methods.name: getPriceText
methods.description: Returns the price text associated with this shipping quote item.

methods.name: setPriceText
methods.description: Sets the price text for this shipping quote item.

methods.name: setMaximumWeight
methods.description: Sets the maximum weight for this shipping quote item.

methods.name: getMaximumWeight
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight for this shipping quote item.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes this object to a JSON string, including the price and maximum weight fields.
